# Compass — ERP Modernization

- **Goal / definition of done:** retire the legacy MRP and go live on **SAP S/4HANA** across all
  four plants, giving one source of truth for planning, purchasing, and costing.
- **Owner:** [Priya Deshmukh](../people/priya-deshmukh.md) (business sponsor); day-to-day led by
  the IT/PMO with heavy Operations input from [Terrence Boyd](../people/terrence-boyd.md).
- **Status:** **DELAYED** (updated 2026-07-09). Go-live has **slipped from September 2026 to
  Q1 2027** after data-migration defects and shop-floor integration problems surfaced in testing.
  **This supersedes the earlier "on schedule" read from the 2026-05-12 Q1 ops review.**
- **Why it matters:** the legacy MRP is what's scrambling purchasing and inventory; the slip
  keeps [Terrence](../people/terrence-boyd.md)'s planning on manual workarounds and delays the
  costing visibility [Priya](../people/priya-deshmukh.md) needs for margin recovery.

## Open items
- Reset and re-baseline the go-live date (target Q1 2027) — needs Ray's approval; see
  [commitments](../commitments.md).
- Clean up the item-master and BOM data before re-attempting migration.
